title: Introspection Query Enabled
description: The GraphQL introspection query is enabled. This allows attackers to enumerate the entire schema.

title: Field Suggestions Enabled
description: Field suggestions are returned when incorrect field names are used in queries.

title: GET Method Query Support
description: GraphQL queries can be sent via GET method, enabling CSRF attacks.

title: Batch Query Support
description: The server supports batch queries which could be abused for DoS.

title: Alias Overloading
description: No limit on alias-based query duplication.
